description: This image displays four separate pie charts, each representing the distribution of response categories for a specific large language model: GPT4-o, Gemini1.5, Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, and Llama3.1-405B-Instruct. Each chart is divided into segments corresponding to distinct response types, with labels and percentages shown within the slices. The GPT4-o chart has two slices: “Safety” (1, 16.7%, light orange) and “Lack of Knowledge” (5, 83.3%, dark red). The Gemini1.5 chart has four slices: “Safety” (8, 9.3%, red), “Lack of Knowledge” (19, 22.1%, blue), “Ethical Advice” (14, 16.3%, light blue), and “Clarification” (12, 14.0%, yellow), with “Misinformation” (33, 38.4%, orange) also present. The Llama3.1-70B-Instruct chart shows two slices: “Lack of Knowledge” (3, 75.0%, orange) and “Clarification” (1, 25.0%, red). The Llama3.1-405B-Instruct chart also has two slices: “Lack of Knowledge” (2, 50.0%, orange) and “Misinformation” (2, 50.0%, red). All charts include percentage labels inside their respective slices and are presented without a legend or visual emphasis like exploded sections.
